name: README HTML
description: Show same-repository HTML documents inline in GitHub READMEs with a #html-preview link.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:; frame-src 'self'; connect-src https://raw.githubusercontent.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
